incident-bot: [ALERT] 2026-03-15T09:12:34Z GPU_HPA_LAG — prometheus-adapter reports delayed metrics; HPA not reacting. queued_inference_requests > 1200, queue growth steady for 6m. Severity: P1

kate (oncall-sre): taking pager. pinging eng-runtime and monitoring. first cut: confirm HPA sees metrics and check adapter logs.

mario (eng-runtime): ack. on it. seeing high queue length on kafka topic inference.requests.high-pri, also many pods in CrashLoopBackOff for worker-quantized-2? will pull kubectl.

kate (oncall-sre): running quick checks:
```
kubectl -n inference get hpa
kubectl -n monitoring get pods | grep adapter
kubectl -n monitoring logs deployment/prometheus-adapter --since=15m
kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide | grep worker
```

mario (eng-runtime): adapter pods are Running but logs show repeated timeouts to Prometheus API: `GET /api/v1/query?query=...: context deadline exceeded`. Prometheus scrape targets look fine though. suspect network blips to prometheus-thanos-query.

prometheus-bot: alert: HighQueryLatency on prometheus-thanos-query (90th p99 queries > 12s)

kate (oncall-sre): that would explain delayed custom metrics. HPA waits for external metrics -> no scale. mitigation plan: 1) manually scale worker replicas to stop immediate throttling 2) restart prometheus-adapter to reestablish metric flow 3) drain/slow new work ingress if needed 4) collect customer impact numbers.

mario (eng-runtime): increasing replicas now — running:
```
kubectl -n inference scale deploy inference-worker --replicas=20
```

ops-shift: note: this will temporarily increase GPU allocation and cost; confirm with finance if long-running.

kate (oncall-sre): doing adapter restart now:
```
kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart deployment prometheus-adapter
```

deploy-bot: rollout started deployment/prometheus-adapter (3 replicas)

kate (oncall-sre): also saw `metrics-server` CPU spikes in last 30m, checking node iptables/conntrack counts. if metrics-server unstable, kube HPA objects relying on resource metrics could be affected too.

mario (eng-runtime): confirmed `kubectl get hpa` still shows TARGETS empty for external metrics. adapter logs after restart show initial scrape errors but then one successful 200 response at +45s.

kate (oncall-sre): nice. give it a minute for HPA to observe new values. meanwhile we should throttle new non-critical traffic to reduce queue growth. ops-shift, can you apply ingress rate-limit for non-enterprise routes?

ops-shift: applying temporary rate-limit on /v1/generate for free-tier and dev keys: 10rps per ip. policy pushed.

customer-success: heads up — we are seeing increased latency and some 429s for free-tier customers. not yet on enterprise SLAs but a few support tickets incoming. tagging customers with >5% errors.

kate (oncall-sre): monitoring dashboards: queue depth stopped growing after manual scale + ingress throttle, current queued_inference_requests down to ~420 from 1200. error rate 429s reduced by 60%.

prometheus-bot: prometheus-adapter: metrics ingestion restored at 2026-03-15T09:19:08Z, external metric `gpu_queue_length` now reporting.

kate (oncall-sre): HPA status now shows increase in desired replicas (10 -> 18) and current inflight scaling. that's good — autoscaler catching up. I'll keep manual scale until HPA stable.

mario (eng-runtime): investigating root cause: Prometheus query latency tied to an overloaded thanos-query instance in eu-west; network egress to monitoring cluster saturated due to backup snapshot job that started ~09:05. opening infra ticket.

alisha (eng-sre): taking over 09:30-17:30 shift. @kate handing off — please summarise current mitigations and outstanding actions. :wave:

kate (oncall-sre): handoff summary:
- Incident: GPU autoscaling delayed due to external metrics lag (prometheus -> adapter) causing HPA to not scale; queue grew to >1200.
- Immediate mitigations applied: manual scale inference-worker -> 20 replicas; restarted prometheus-adapter; applied ingress rate-limit for non-enterprise routes; drained backlog with added workers.
- Current status: queued_inference_requests ~ 380, error 429s reduced, HPA now seeing metric and scaling towards desired replicas.
- Outstanding: investigate root cause of thanos/query overload (mario), confirm no lasting config regression in backup jobs (infra), evaluate whether adapters need retries/backoff tuning (eng-runtime), check metrics-server spikes (eng-sre).

alisha (eng-sre): ack. I'll keep autoscaling manual override in place until HPA stabilizes for 15m and then remove manual scale. also will add a temporary autoscaler policy to prefer quick scale-up for GPU-backed pools.

mario (eng-runtime): infra: opened ticket INF-8123 with infra oncall, linking logs and timeframe. backup snapshot job overlapped with heavy query windows — they are pausing snapshots for 30m to see effect.

customer-success: created support digest and emailed impacted free-tier customers; no enterprise customers impacted yet per initial checks. will update if any enterprise reports.

ops-shift: cost note: current manual scale added ~6 GPUs for ~20m; estimate extra spend ~ $120. logging cost impact.

kate (oncall-sre): follow-up actions recorded in #incidents runbook entry. will paste quick commands used for postmortem collection:
```
kubectl -n monitoring logs deployment/prometheus-adapter --since=2h > /tmp/adapter-logs.txt
kubectl -n inference top pods --containers > /tmp/inference-top.txt
aws s3 cp /tmp/adapter-logs.txt s3://redwood-incident-archives/INC-2143/adapter-logs.txt
```

alisha (eng-sre): I'll monitor for 20m and then remove manual scale if HPA reported desired ~= current and queue stable <200. if queue spikes again, escalate to P0 and re-open pager.

mario (eng-runtime): infra confirmed pause of snapshot jobs; thanos-query p99 latency dropped back to baseline ~2s at 09:24. adapter metrics look healthy.

kate (oncall-sre): wrapping — handing to @alisha. I remain reachable if needed. great quick team response. :thumbsup:

alisha (eng-sre): taking the rest of the incident. current plan: observe 20m, collect metrics for postmortem, tag as INC-2143, prepare customer impact notes for comms. will coordinate postmortem with eng-runtime and infra tomorrow.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2143 created and linked to this thread. severity P1 -> downgraded to P2 at 2026-03-15T09:36Z after stabilisation.

alisha (eng-sre): final note for thread: root cause likely overlapping heavy backup job causing thanos/prometheus query saturation -> adapter timeouts -> HPA metric delay. mitigations: pause backups near peak, add adapter retry/backoff and circuit breakers, add alert for external-metric-empty-targets, and run a capacity test on thanos-query. will include these in the postmortem action items.

customer-success: will draft a short status update for affected customers and include recovery ETA + apology.

alisha (eng-sre): closing thread for now, will reopen if we see regressions.
